title: APPENDIX: A SUPPLEMENTAL HISTORY
text:
14        APPENDIX: A SUPPLEMENTAL HISTORY

had been rendered by her grandmother, Lee Lindsey (Mrs. W. B.) DuJerrett, upon her own graduation many years previous. Happy memories of other days were brought to mind by the singing of "The Old, Old Story" by Mrs. Blanche Ragland, accompanied by her own daughter.

The principal address of the occasion was delivered by Lee A. Clark, in which he praised the students of his day and time in overcoming difficulties in their determination to secure an education. A recess period of two hours followed the morning session, in which lunch was served in picnic style in the Beautiful College Campus.

The afternoon session was opened with a sing-song led by Mrs. Lewis J. Reynolds. Eldridge Lee Lindsey (Mrs. S. H.) Montgomery paid a tribute to old students recently passing on. An amendment to the Association Constitution, offered by Gus W. Thomassen, was adopted, giving the Board of Managers the right to call a spring meeting in place of an annual meeting. President John Marcus Gist extended an invitation to come to Sherman if they failed to meet another year at Milford as his guests. The invitation was acknowledged with expressions of appreciation. It was the last opportunity we ever heard John Marcus Gist give to have at this juncture he was bid farewell by the audience in singing "God Be With You Till We Meet Again."

Lewis J. Reynolds and Edgar Anderson McMahon joined in paying tribute to Martha Buford May for rendering of her services as secretary-treasurer and as a willing and tireless worker in promoting the welfare of the Association. They proposed the creation of a post of honor, to be known as Past Laureate, and recommend Mrs. Buford May for it. A proposal was adopted by unanimous vote.

Telegrams were received from two, notied of their inability to be present from Mrs. Pamela Paxton Boyd and family of, and Mrs. Gus B. and Mrs. Harvey Johnson.

Officers selected for the ensuing year were as follows: President, Lee A. Clark; vice-president, Lee Lindsey (Mrs. Dr. W. B.) DuJerrett; active vice-president, Edgar Anderson McMahon; secretary-treasurer-post laureate, Martha Buford (Mrs. J. B.) May; historian-librarian, Pamelia Pax-
